author: /root/sizing_locales_c
translation_method: Full-body translation of the exact reviewed English candidate; the former body was read as context and is preserved separately as before-state.
product_name_handling: Both English proper product-name bases are preserved exactly. Short-Sleeve Set and Long-Sleeve Set suffixes are translated; the name Gauze is not treated as independently verified material composition.

ambiguities.handling: The copy explicitly asks customers to contact the store before sizing to confirm units and body-versus-garment measurement meaning. No unit or product fact is inferred.

scope_notes: Holiday morning remains a general festive occasion; Christmas-morning planning remains explicit where present in the English source.
Sleepwear warnings retain uncertainty and intended-fit/label conditions; no product or cross-jurisdiction compliance certification is added.
All six checklist steps, two product examples, care instructions and final size/pieces/quantity checks are retained.
qualification: Multilingual model author. This author check is not an independent review or human-native language certification.
limits: A different reviewer must assess the exact candidate before publication.
No external system, destination navigation, product availability, safety-label or live-language-market verification was performed by this author.
The source CPSC link and wording are preserved from the parent-reviewed English candidate; no new legal or product-safety claims are introduced.
source_authority_for_revision: Parent explicit revision-2 assignment and ENGLISH_REVISION_2.json bind the revised English candidate; root owns release-plan integration.

version_provenance.only_revision2_change: Appended the required chart-unit clarification to the Meow product-example bullet; all other localized bytes, elements and links are preserved.
version_provenance.exact_english_addition: This chart's unit labels need clarification. Contact us to confirm the units and whether the figures are body or garment measurements before choosing a size.
version_provenance.exact_localized_addition: この表の単位表記には確認が必要です。サイズを選ぶ前にお問い合わせいただき、単位と、数値が身体の寸法か衣服の寸法かを確認してください。
